findings.title: 13 moderate vulnerabilities in @opentelemetry/* via @grafana/faro-web-tracing <=2.7.1
findings.detail: GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf: OpenTelemetry Core unbounded memory allocation in W3C Baggage propagation (CVSS 5.3). Affects @opentelemetry/core <2.8.0 and all transitive dependents. Root cause: @grafana/faro-web-sdk and @grafana/faro-web-tracing pinned at ^2.4.0 in package.json. Upgrading to ^2.8.2 resolves all 13 advisories. Fix was applied and verified: branch claude-maintenance/2026-07-09-grafana-security-bump pushed to origin with 0 vulnerabilities, 351 tests passing, and build succeeding. PR could not be created: GH_TOKEN PAT lacks createPullRequest scope and cannot be bypassed in this environment.
findings.suggested_fix: Open a PR from branch claude-maintenance/2026-07-09-grafana-security-bump to main — the fix is ready and tested

findings.title: react and react-dom are one major version behind (18.3.1 installed, 19.2.7 available)
findings.detail: package.json pins react and react-dom at ^18.3.1; npm outdated reports latest is 19.2.7. React 19 is a major version with breaking changes. Not safe to auto-upgrade without review and testing.
findings.suggested_fix: Manually review React 19 migration guide, update @types/react and @types/react-dom alongside react and react-dom, then bump to ^19.0.0 in package.json

findings.title: All recent main-branch CI runs show conclusion: skipped
findings.detail: Last 5 runs of the Claude Code workflow on main branch all have conclusion=skipped. This is expected: the Claude Code workflow has PR-only triggers. Claude Code Review and Release workflows succeed on their respective branches. No actual test/build failures detected.
findings.suggested_fix: No action required; skipped status is expected for PR-gated workflows on direct pushes to main
